content.description: Lore is a cross-chain natural language explorer and AI-enabled analytics platform. Blockchain analytics data is often obscure and difficult to interpret, making it hard to gauge real signal and narratives on-chain; querying on-chain data can be complicated and may require expensive technical hires. Lore addresses these challenges with its AI-enabled analytics platform to help users interpret, analyze, and act on on-chain data.
